Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.zh-Hant: 自動標記是未經驗證的估算。手腕動作不能確認觸球時刻。解讀節奏前請校正標記。
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.es: Los marcadores automáticos son estimaciones sin validar. La muñeca no confirma el impacto. Corrígelos antes de interpretar el tempo.
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.pt-BR: Marcadores automáticos são estimativas não validadas. O punho não confirma o impacto. Corrija-os antes de interpretar o tempo.
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.de: Automatische Markierungen sind unvalidierte Schätzungen. Handgelenkbewegung belegt keinen Ballkontakt. Korrigiere die Markierungen vor der Tempoauswertung.
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.fr: Les repères automatiques sont des estimations non validées. Le poignet ne prouve pas l’impact. Corrigez les repères avant d’interpréter le tempo.
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.it: I marcatori automatici sono stime non validate. Il movimento dei polsi non prova l’impatto. Correggili prima di interpretare il tempo.
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.th: เครื่องหมายอัตโนมัติเป็นค่าประมาณที่ยังไม่ผ่านการตรวจสอบ การเคลื่อนไหวข้อมือไม่ยืนยันการกระทบลูก แก้ไขเครื่องหมายก่อนตีความจังหวะ
Automatic markers are unvalidated estima.vi: Mốc tự động là ước tính chưa được xác thực. Chuyển động cổ tay không xác nhận lúc chạm bóng. Hãy chỉnh mốc trước khi diễn giải nhịp độ.

Both recordings have the same marked bac.ko: 두 영상의 표시된 백스윙 시간이 같습니다. 같은 드릴을 반복해 일관성을 확인하세요.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.ja: 両動画のマーカー上のバックスイング時間は同じです。ドリルを繰り返して安定性を確認しましょう。
Both recordings have the same marked bac.zh-Hans: 两段录像标记的上杆时长相同。请重复练习以检查一致性。
Both recordings have the same marked bac.zh-Hant: 兩段錄影標記的上桿時長相同。請重複練習以檢查一致性。
Both recordings have the same marked bac.es: Ambas grabaciones tienen la misma duración marcada de subida. Repite el ejercicio para comprobar la consistencia.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.pt-BR: As duas gravações têm a mesma duração marcada de subida. Repita o exercício para verificar a consistência.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.de: Beide Aufnahmen haben die gleiche markierte Rückschwungdauer. Wiederhole die Übung, um die Konstanz zu prüfen.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.fr: Les deux vidéos ont la même durée de montée marquée. Répétez l’exercice pour vérifier la régularité.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.it: Entrambi i video hanno la stessa durata marcata del backswing. Ripeti l’esercizio per verificare la costanza.
Both recordings have the same marked bac.th: ทั้งสองวิดีโอมีระยะเวลาแบ็กสวิงตามเครื่องหมายเท่ากัน ทำแบบฝึกซ้ำเพื่อตรวจสอบความสม่ำเสมอ
Both recordings have the same marked bac.vi: Hai video có thời lượng backswing được đánh dấu bằng nhau. Lặp lại bài tập để kiểm tra sự ổn định.

Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.ko: 클럽 헤드 속도, 볼 스피드, 발사각, 캐리, 스핀은 제공되지 않습니다. 학습된 클럽·공 감지기는 포함되어 있지 않습니다. 자세 분석으로 이 값을 측정할 수 없습니다.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.ja: ヘッド速度、ボール速度、打ち出し角、キャリー、スピンは利用できません。学習済みのクラブ・ボール検出器は含まれず、姿勢解析では測定できません。
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.zh-Hans: 杆头速度、球速、起飞角、空中距离及旋转不可用。未集成训练好的球杆或球检测器。身体姿态不能测量这些数值。
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.zh-Hant: 桿頭速度、球速、起飛角、空中距離及旋轉無法提供。未整合訓練好的球桿或球偵測器。身體姿態不能測量這些數值。
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.es: Velocidad del palo y la bola, ángulo de salida, vuelo y efecto no disponibles. No hay detector entrenado de palo o bola. La postura no mide estos valores.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.pt-BR: Velocidades do taco e da bola, ângulo de saída, carry e rotação indisponíveis. Não há detector treinado de taco ou bola. A postura não mede esses valores.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.de: Schlägerkopf- und Ballgeschwindigkeit, Abflugwinkel, Carry und Spin sind nicht verfügbar. Kein trainierter Schläger- oder Balldetektor ist integriert. Körperpose misst diese Werte nicht.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.fr: Vitesse de tête et de balle, angle de lancement, portée aérienne et spin indisponibles. Aucun détecteur entraîné de club ou de balle n’est intégré. La posture ne mesure pas ces valeurs.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.it: Velocità di testa e palla, angolo di lancio, carry e spin non disponibili. Nessun rilevatore addestrato di bastone o palla è incluso. La postura non misura questi valori.
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.th: ไม่มีข้อมูลความเร็วหัวไม้ ความเร็วลูก มุมเหิน ระยะลอย และสปิน ยังไม่มีตัวตรวจจับไม้หรือลูกที่ฝึกแล้ว ท่าทางร่างกายไม่สามารถวัดค่าเหล่านี้ได้
Club-head speed, ball speed, launch angl.vi: Không có tốc độ đầu gậy, tốc độ bóng, góc phóng, carry và độ xoáy. Chưa tích hợp bộ phát hiện gậy hoặc bóng đã huấn luyện. Tư thế cơ thể không đo được các giá trị này.

Compare recordings from the same camera.ko: 같은 카메라 각도와 위치에서 촬영한 영상을 비교하세요. 이 값은 2D 투영이며 해부학적 3D 측정이 아닙니다.
Compare recordings from the same camera.ja: 同じ角度・位置からの動画を比較してください。これは2D投影であり、解剖学的な3D測定ではありません。
Compare recordings from the same camera.zh-Hans: 请对比相同角度和位置拍摄的录像。这些是二维投影，并非解剖学三维测量。
Compare recordings from the same camera.zh-Hant: 請比較相同角度和位置拍攝的錄影。這些是二維投影，並非解剖學三維測量。
Compare recordings from the same camera.es: Compara grabaciones con el mismo ángulo y posición. Son proyecciones 2D, no medidas anatómicas 3D.
Compare recordings from the same camera.pt-BR: Compare gravações do mesmo ângulo e posição. São projeções 2D, não medidas anatômicas 3D.
Compare recordings from the same camera.de: Vergleiche Aufnahmen mit gleichem Kamerawinkel und Standort. Dies sind 2D-Projektionen, keine anatomischen 3D-Messungen.
Compare recordings from the same camera.fr: Comparez des vidéos prises au même angle et endroit. Ce sont des projections 2D, pas des mesures anatomiques 3D.
Compare recordings from the same camera.it: Confronta video dalla stessa angolazione e posizione. Sono proiezioni 2D, non misure anatomiche 3D.
Compare recordings from the same camera.th: เปรียบเทียบวิดีโอจากมุมและตำแหน่งกล้องเดียวกัน ค่านี้เป็นภาพฉาย 2 มิติ ไม่ใช่การวัดกายวิภาค 3 มิติ
Compare recordings from the same camera.vi: So sánh video từ cùng góc và vị trí camera. Đây là hình chiếu 2D, không phải phép đo giải phẫu 3D.

Different or unspecified camera angles..ko: 촬영 각도가 다르거나 지정되지 않았습니다. 움직임 비교가 부정확할 수 있습니다.
Different or unspecified camera angles..ja: 撮影角度が異なるか未指定です。動きの比較を誤解する可能性があります。
Different or unspecified camera angles..zh-Hans: 拍摄角度不同或未指定。动作对比可能产生误导。
Different or unspecified camera angles..zh-Hant: 拍攝角度不同或未指定。動作比較可能產生誤導。
Different or unspecified camera angles..es: Ángulos distintos o sin especificar. La comparación puede resultar engañosa.
Different or unspecified camera angles..pt-BR: Ângulos diferentes ou não especificados. A comparação pode ser enganosa.
Different or unspecified camera angles..de: Abweichende oder unbekannte Kamerawinkel. Bewegungsvergleiche können irreführend sein.
Different or unspecified camera angles..fr: Angles différents ou non précisés. La comparaison peut être trompeuse.
Different or unspecified camera angles..it: Angolazioni diverse o non specificate. Il confronto può essere fuorviante.
Different or unspecified camera angles..th: มุมกล้องต่างกันหรือไม่ได้ระบุ การเทียบการเคลื่อนไหวอาจทำให้เข้าใจผิด
Different or unspecified camera angles..vi: Góc quay khác nhau hoặc chưa xác định. So sánh chuyển động có thể gây hiểu nhầm.

Phase markers are estimates. Review and.ko: 단계 표시는 추정입니다. 템포를 사용하기 전에 검토하고 수정하세요.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.ja: フェーズマーカーは推定です。テンポを利用する前に確認・修正してください。
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.zh-Hans: 阶段标记为估算。使用节奏前请检查并校正。
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.zh-Hant: 階段標記為估算。使用節奏前請檢查並校正。
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.es: Los marcadores son estimaciones. Revísalos y corrígelos antes de usar el tempo.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.pt-BR: Os marcadores são estimativas. Revise e corrija antes de usar o tempo.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.de: Phasenmarkierungen sind Schätzungen. Prüfe und korrigiere sie vor der Temponutzung.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.fr: Les repères sont des estimations. Vérifiez-les et corrigez-les avant d’utiliser le tempo.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.it: I marcatori sono stime. Verificali e correggili prima di usare il tempo.
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.th: เครื่องหมายช่วงเป็นค่าประมาณ ตรวจสอบและแก้ไขก่อนใช้จังหวะ
Phase markers are estimates. Review and.vi: Các mốc giai đoạn là ước tính. Kiểm tra và chỉnh lại trước khi dùng nhịp độ.

Phase markers must follow chronological.ko: 단계 표시는 시간순이어야 합니다. 충돌하는 표시를 지우거나 다른 프레임을 선택하세요.
Phase markers must follow chronological.ja: マーカーは時系列順に設定してください。競合するマーカーを消すか、別のフレームを選んでください。
Phase markers must follow chronological.zh-Hans: 阶段标记必须按时间顺序排列。请清除冲突标记或选择其他帧。
Phase markers must follow chronological.zh-Hant: 階段標記必須按時間順序排列。請清除衝突標記或選擇其他影格。
Phase markers must follow chronological.es: Los marcadores deben seguir el orden temporal. Borra el que entra en conflicto o elige otro fotograma.
Phase markers must follow chronological.pt-BR: Os marcadores devem seguir a ordem temporal. Apague o conflitante ou escolha outro quadro.
Phase markers must follow chronological.de: Phasen müssen zeitlich geordnet sein. Lösche eine widersprüchliche Markierung oder wähle ein anderes Bild.
Phase markers must follow chronological.fr: Les repères doivent suivre l’ordre chronologique. Effacez le repère en conflit ou choisissez une autre image.
Phase markers must follow chronological.it: I marcatori devono essere in ordine cronologico. Cancella quello in conflitto o scegli un altro fotogramma.
Phase markers must follow chronological.th: เครื่องหมายต้องเรียงตามเวลา ล้างเครื่องหมายที่ขัดกันหรือเลือกเฟรมอื่น
Phase markers must follow chronological.vi: Các mốc phải theo thứ tự thời gian. Xóa mốc xung đột hoặc chọn khung hình khác.

Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.ko: 자세는 영상에서 도출된 2D 기하 정보이며 신체의 3D 측정이 아닙니다.
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.ja: 姿勢は画像から推定した2D形状であり、身体の3D測定ではありません。
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.zh-Hans: 姿态是视觉推导的二维图像几何信息，并非三维身体测量。
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.zh-Hant: 姿態是視覺推導的二維影像幾何資訊，並非三維身體測量。
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.es: La postura es geometría 2D derivada de visión, no una medición corporal 3D.
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.pt-BR: A postura é geometria 2D derivada de visão, não uma medição corporal 3D.
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.fr: La posture est une géométrie 2D issue de la vision, pas une mesure corporelle 3D.
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.it: La postura è geometria 2D derivata dalla visione, non una misura corporea 3D.
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.th: ท่าทางเป็นเรขาคณิตภาพ 2 มิติที่ได้จากการมองเห็น ไม่ใช่การวัดร่างกาย 3 มิติ
Pose is vision-derived 2D image geometry.vi: Tư thế là hình học ảnh 2D suy ra từ thị giác, không phải phép đo cơ thể 3D.

Record or import a video to review it fr.ko: 영상을 촬영하거나 가져와 프레임별로 검토하고 iPhone에서 자세를 분석하세요.
Record or import a video to review it fr.ja: 動画を撮影・読み込みして、iPhone上でコマ送り確認と姿勢解析ができます。
Record or import a video to review it fr.zh-Hans: 录制或导入视频，在 iPhone 上逐帧回顾并分析身体姿态。
Record or import a video to review it fr.zh-Hant: 錄製或匯入影片，在 iPhone 上逐格檢視並分析身體姿態。
Record or import a video to review it fr.es: Graba o importa un vídeo para revisarlo fotograma a fotograma y analizar la postura en tu iPhone.
Record or import a video to review it fr.pt-BR: Grave ou importe um vídeo para rever quadro a quadro e analisar a postura no iPhone.
Record or import a video to review it fr.de: Nimm ein Video auf oder importiere es, um Einzelbilder und Körperpose auf deinem iPhone zu analysieren.
Record or import a video to review it fr.fr: Filmez ou importez une vidéo pour la revoir image par image et analyser la posture sur votre iPhone.
Record or import a video to review it fr.it: Registra o importa un video per rivederlo fotogramma per fotogramma e analizzare la postura su iPhone.
Record or import a video to review it fr.th: บันทึกหรือนำเข้าวิดีโอเพื่อดูทีละเฟรมและวิเคราะห์ท่าทางบน iPhone
Record or import a video to review it fr.vi: Quay hoặc nhập video để xem từng khung hình và phân tích tư thế trên iPhone.

Record or import two swings to compare t.ko: 두 스윙을 촬영하거나 가져와 움직임과 타이밍을 비교하세요.
Record or import two swings to compare t.ja: 2つのスイングを撮影・読み込みして、動きとタイミングを比較しましょう。
Record or import two swings to compare t.zh-Hans: 录制或导入两次挥杆，以对比动作和时序。
Record or import two swings to compare t.zh-Hant: 錄製或匯入兩次揮桿，以比較動作和時序。
Record or import two swings to compare t.es: Graba o importa dos swings para comparar movimiento y tiempos.
Record or import two swings to compare t.pt-BR: Grave ou importe dois swings para comparar movimento e tempo.
Record or import two swings to compare t.de: Nimm zwei Schwünge auf oder importiere sie, um Bewegung und Timing zu vergleichen.
Record or import two swings to compare t.fr: Filmez ou importez deux swings pour comparer mouvement et rythme.
Record or import two swings to compare t.it: Registra o importa due swing per confrontare movimento e tempi.
Record or import two swings to compare t.th: บันทึกหรือนำเข้าสองวงสวิงเพื่อเทียบการเคลื่อนไหวและจังหวะ
Record or import two swings to compare t.vi: Quay hoặc nhập hai cú swing để so sánh chuyển động và thời gian.

Review both phase timelines before compa.ko: 타이밍을 비교하기 전에 두 영상의 단계 시간표를 검토하세요.
Review both phase timelines before compa.ja: タイミングを比較する前に両方のフェーズ時系列を確認してください。
Review both phase timelines before compa.zh-Hans: 比较时序前，请检查两段录像的阶段时间线。
Review both phase timelines before compa.zh-Hant: 比較時序前，請檢查兩段錄影的階段時間軸。
Review both phase timelines before compa.es: Revisa las fases de ambas grabaciones antes de comparar tiempos.
Review both phase timelines before compa.pt-BR: Revise as fases das duas gravações antes de comparar os tempos.
Review both phase timelines before compa.de: Prüfe beide Phasenabläufe vor dem Timingvergleich.
Review both phase timelines before compa.fr: Vérifiez les deux chronologies de phases avant de comparer le rythme.
Review both phase timelines before compa.it: Rivedi entrambe le sequenze delle fasi prima di confrontare i tempi.
Review both phase timelines before compa.th: ตรวจสอบลำดับช่วงของทั้งสองวิดีโอก่อนเทียบจังหวะ
Review both phase timelines before compa.vi: Kiểm tra dòng thời gian giai đoạn của cả hai trước khi so sánh.

The second recording has a longer backsw.ko: 두 번째 영상의 백스윙 시간이 더 깁니다. 같은 드릴을 반복하고 다음 영상과 비교하세요.
The second recording has a longer backsw.ja: 2つ目の動画はバックスイング時間が長くなっています。同じドリルを繰り返して次の動画と比較しましょう。
The second recording has a longer backsw.zh-Hans: 第二段录像的上杆时间更长。请重复相同练习，并与下次录像比较。
The second recording has a longer backsw.zh-Hant: 第二段錄影的上桿時間更長。請重複相同練習，並與下次錄影比較。
The second recording has a longer backsw.es: La segunda grabación tiene una subida más larga. Repite el ejercicio y compara la próxima grabación.
The second recording has a longer backsw.pt-BR: A segunda gravação tem uma subida mais longa. Repita o exercício e compare a próxima gravação.
The second recording has a longer backsw.de: Die zweite Aufnahme hat einen längeren Rückschwung. Wiederhole die Übung und vergleiche die nächste Aufnahme.
The second recording has a longer backsw.fr: La deuxième vidéo présente une montée plus longue. Répétez l’exercice et comparez la prochaine vidéo.
The second recording has a longer backsw.it: Il secondo video ha un backswing più lungo. Ripeti l’esercizio e confronta la prossima registrazione.
The second recording has a longer backsw.th: วิดีโอที่สองมีแบ็กสวิงนานกว่า ทำแบบฝึกเดิมซ้ำแล้วเทียบกับวิดีโอถัดไป
The second recording has a longer backsw.vi: Video thứ hai có backswing dài hơn. Lặp lại cùng bài tập và so sánh với video tiếp theo.

The second recording has a shorter backs.ko: 두 번째 영상의 백스윙 시간이 더 짧습니다. 같은 드릴을 반복하고 다음 영상과 비교하세요.
The second recording has a shorter backs.ja: 2つ目の動画はバックスイング時間が短くなっています。同じドリルを繰り返して次の動画と比較しましょう。
The second recording has a shorter backs.zh-Hans: 第二段录像的上杆时间更短。请重复相同练习，并与下次录像比较。
The second recording has a shorter backs.zh-Hant: 第二段錄影的上桿時間更短。請重複相同練習，並與下次錄影比較。
The second recording has a shorter backs.es: La segunda grabación tiene una subida más corta. Repite el ejercicio y compara la próxima grabación.
The second recording has a shorter backs.pt-BR: A segunda gravação tem uma subida mais curta. Repita o exercício e compare a próxima gravação.
The second recording has a shorter backs.de: Die zweite Aufnahme hat einen kürzeren Rückschwung. Wiederhole die Übung und vergleiche die nächste Aufnahme.
The second recording has a shorter backs.fr: La deuxième vidéo présente une montée plus courte. Répétez l’exercice et comparez la prochaine vidéo.
The second recording has a shorter backs.it: Il secondo video ha un backswing più breve. Ripeti l’esercizio e confronta la prossima registrazione.
The second recording has a shorter backs.th: วิดีโอที่สองมีแบ็กสวิงสั้นกว่า ทำแบบฝึกเดิมซ้ำแล้วเทียบกับวิดีโอถัดไป
The second recording has a shorter backs.vi: Video thứ hai có backswing ngắn hơn. Lặp lại cùng bài tập và so sánh với video tiếp theo.

Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.ko: 타이밍은 표시의 정확도에 따라 달라집니다. 이 비교는 스윙 결함을 진단하지 않습니다.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.ja: タイミングはマーカーの精度に依存します。この比較はスイングの欠点を診断するものではありません。
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.zh-Hans: 时序取决于标记准确度。此对比不用于诊断挥杆缺陷。
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.zh-Hant: 時序取決於標記準確度。此比較不用於診斷揮桿缺陷。
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.es: Los tiempos dependen de los marcadores. Esta comparación no diagnostica fallos del swing.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.pt-BR: Os tempos dependem da precisão dos marcadores. Esta comparação não diagnostica falhas no swing.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.de: Timing hängt von der Genauigkeit der Markierungen ab. Dieser Vergleich diagnostiziert keine Schwungfehler.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.fr: Le rythme dépend de la précision des repères. Cette comparaison ne diagnostique pas un défaut de swing.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.it: I tempi dipendono dalla precisione dei marcatori. Il confronto non diagnostica difetti dello swing.
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.th: จังหวะขึ้นกับความแม่นยำของเครื่องหมาย การเปรียบเทียบนี้ไม่วินิจฉัยข้อบกพร่องของวงสวิง
Timing depends on marker accuracy. This.vi: Thời gian phụ thuộc độ chính xác của mốc. So sánh này không chẩn đoán lỗi swing.

Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.ko: 영상마다 한 골퍼의 스윙 하나만 담으세요. 밝은 곳에서 전신이 보이게 하세요. 분석은 초당 최대 30프레임을 사용합니다.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.ja: 1動画につき1人・1スイングを撮影し、明るい場所で全身を映してください。解析は最大毎秒30フレームです。
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.zh-Hans: 每段视频只包含一名球手的一次挥杆。请确保光线充足且全身可见。分析每秒最多采样30帧。
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.zh-Hant: 每段影片只包含一名球手的一次揮桿。請確保光線充足且全身可見。分析每秒最多取樣30影格。
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.es: Un golfista y un swing por vídeo, cuerpo entero y buena luz. El análisis muestrea hasta 30 fotogramas por segundo.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.pt-BR: Um golfista e um swing por vídeo, corpo inteiro e boa luz. A análise usa até 30 quadros por segundo.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.de: Ein Golfer und ein Schwung pro Clip. Zeige den ganzen Körper bei gutem Licht. Die Analyse nutzt bis zu 30 Bilder pro Sekunde.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.fr: Un golfeur et un swing par vidéo, corps entier et bon éclairage. L’analyse utilise jusqu’à 30 images par seconde.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.it: Un golfista e uno swing per video, corpo intero e buona luce. L’analisi campiona fino a 30 fotogrammi al secondo.
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.th: หนึ่งนักกอล์ฟและหนึ่งวงสวิงต่อคลิป ให้เห็นเต็มตัวในแสงที่ดี วิเคราะห์สูงสุด 30 เฟรมต่อวินาที
Use one golfer and one swing per clip. K.vi: Mỗi video chỉ một người và một cú swing. Giữ toàn thân rõ trong ánh sáng tốt. Phân tích tối đa 30 khung hình mỗi giây.

Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.ko: 한 골퍼의 스윙 하나를 흔들림 없는 카메라로 촬영하세요.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.ja: 1動画につき1人・1スイングを、固定したカメラで撮影してください。
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.zh-Hans: 每段视频只拍一名球手的一次挥杆，并保持相机稳定。
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.zh-Hant: 每段影片只拍一名球手的一次揮桿，並保持相機穩定。
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.es: Un golfista, una cámara estable y un swing por vídeo.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.pt-BR: Um golfista, câmera estável e um swing por vídeo.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.de: Ein Golfer, eine ruhige Kamera und ein Schwung pro Clip.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.fr: Un golfeur, une caméra stable et un swing par vidéo.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.it: Un golfista, fotocamera stabile e uno swing per video.
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.th: หนึ่งนักกอล์ฟ กล้องนิ่ง และหนึ่งวงสวิงต่อคลิป
Use one golfer, a steady camera, and one.vi: Một người chơi, camera ổn định và một cú swing mỗi video.

Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.ko: 영상과 자세 분석은 iPhone에 저장됩니다. 카메라는 무음으로 촬영하며 가져온 영상의 원래 오디오는 유지됩니다.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.ja: 動画と姿勢解析はiPhone内に保存されます。撮影は無音で、読み込んだ動画の音声は保持されます。
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.zh-Hans: 视频和姿态分析保存在你的 iPhone 上。相机录制无声，导入视频保留原始音频。
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.zh-Hant: 影片和姿態分析儲存在你的 iPhone 上。相機錄製無聲，匯入影片保留原始音訊。
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.es: Los vídeos y análisis quedan en tu iPhone. La cámara graba sin sonido. Los vídeos importados conservan su audio.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.pt-BR: Vídeos e análises ficam no iPhone. A câmera grava sem som. Vídeos importados mantêm o áudio original.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.de: Videos und Poseanalysen bleiben auf deinem iPhone. Kameraaufnahmen sind stumm. Importierte Videos behalten ihren Ton.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.fr: Les vidéos et analyses restent sur votre iPhone. La caméra filme sans son. L’audio des vidéos importées est conservé.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.it: Video e analisi restano su iPhone. La fotocamera registra senza audio. I video importati mantengono l’audio originale.
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.th: วิดีโอและการวิเคราะห์ท่าทางอยู่บน iPhone การบันทึกกล้องไม่มีเสียง วิดีโอนำเข้าคงเสียงเดิม
Videos and pose analysis stay on your iP.vi: Video và phân tích tư thế lưu trên iPhone. Camera quay không âm thanh. Video nhập giữ nguyên âm thanh gốc.

Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.ko: 영상 분석으로 도출한 어드레스부터 임팩트까지 코의 최대 변위이며 정규화된 영상 좌표를 사용합니다. 카메라 움직임과 원근에 영향을 받는 대리지표입니다.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.ja: 画像解析による、アドレスからインパクトまでの鼻の最大変位です。正規化画像座標を用いた指標で、カメラの動きや遠近法に影響されます。
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.zh-Hans: 通过视觉推导，从准备姿势到触球时鼻子的最大位移，以归一化图像坐标表示。此代理指标受相机移动及透视影响。
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.zh-Hant: 透過視覺推導，從準備姿勢到觸球時鼻子的最大位移，以正規化影像座標表示。此代理指標受相機移動及透視影響。
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.es: Desplazamiento máximo de la nariz entre colocación e impacto, derivado de visión en coordenadas normalizadas. Cámara y perspectiva afectan este indicador.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.pt-BR: Deslocamento máximo do nariz entre posição inicial e impacto, derivado de visão em coordenadas normalizadas. Movimento da câmera e perspectiva afetam o indicador.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.de: Bildbasierte maximale Nasenverschiebung von Ansprechposition bis Treffmoment in normierten Bildkoordinaten. Kamerabewegung und Perspektive beeinflussen diesen Näherungswert.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.fr: Déplacement maximal du nez entre adresse et impact, issu de la vision en coordonnées normalisées. Caméra et perspective influencent cet indicateur.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.it: Spostamento massimo del naso da address a impatto, derivato dalla visione in coordinate normalizzate. Movimento della fotocamera e prospettiva influenzano questo indicatore.
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.th: การกระจัดสูงสุดของจมูกจากท่าจรดลูกถึงอิมแพคจากภาพในพิกัดมาตรฐาน การเคลื่อนกล้องและมุมมองมีผลต่อตัวชี้วัดแทนนี้
Vision-derived maximum nose displacement.vi: Độ dịch chuyển mũi tối đa từ vào bóng đến tiếp xúc, suy ra từ thị giác theo tọa độ ảnh chuẩn hóa. Chuyển động camera và phối cảnh ảnh hưởng chỉ số đại diện này.
